periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, tapering towards the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval profile, with a longitudinal length approximately 1.5 times the transverse width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering, creating a teardrop shape where the lowest point is notably distal from the geometric center.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Substantial lateral separation, with the gap between ears measuring approximately twice the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, parabolic curvature across the top boundary with no visible flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-rufous tinting present on the typically white fur of the torso and limbs.
